None of them resolve FM_HOME, so they do not cross-wire the homes. FirstMate's own hooks are PROJECT-scoped via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in <code_root>/.claude/settings.json, so this home's session loads the cleanroom checkout's bin/ scripts.

claude, codex, pi, herdr, treehouse, tasks-axi, quota-axi, lavish-axi, gh-axi and no-mistakes are single host-wide installs. Upgrading tasks-axi / lavish-axi / quota-axi to clear this environment's floors would also change the tools the other, currently LIVE home uses mid-flight. This is the unavoidable local setup effect and it is a captain decision, not a mechanical fix.
